shots.what_it_taught: The request is about time-to-death and this system has no layer for it. Not a missing parameter set, not an out-of-scope clade: a missing dimension. Every other use case in runs/ was refused by something; this one is refused by an absence.
The anatomy layer does well here -- five organ systems and forty-odd cell types for a real insect. It is simply not the layer the question was about.

Walking is not contradicted and flight is refused for want of a lift coefficient measured on anything like an insect. Neither bears on lifespan. The locomotion layer is a second dimension beside shape, and the request was about a third one that still has no layer.

29 taxa are on record as eating this clade -- damselflies, orb-weavers, dragonflies, bush-crickets -- each traceable to a study. That is the nearest this system gets to the question, and it is not very near: a list of predators is not a mortality rate, and without a rate a longer intrinsic lifespan is not a longer life.
